spans.s:
अल अल, अम्, n. (said to be fr. rt. अल्), the
sting in the tail of a scorpion; yellow orpiment. See आल.
अल्ला अल्ला, f. a mother; voc. अल्ल.

आल आल, अम्, n. spawn, any discharge of
venomous matter from poisonous animals; yellow
arsenic, orpiment; (अस्, आ, अम्), not small, large, ex-
tensive.
—आलाक्त (˚ल-अक्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. anointed
with poison (as an arrow).

अलक अलक, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be fr.
rt. अल्), a curl, lock; (अस्), m. a mad dog [cf. अलर्क];
(आ), f. a girl from eight to ten years of age; N. of the
capital of Kuvera, situated on a peak of the Himālaya
inhabited also by Śiva.
—अलक-त्व, अम्, n. the state
of a curl or tress.
—अलक-नन्दा, f. a young girl
from eight to ten years old; N. of the Gaṅgā river;
N. of a river that runs from the Himālaya moun-
tains and falls into the Gaṅgā.
—अलक-प्रभा,
f. the capital of Kuvera.
—अलक-प्रिय, अस्, m., N.
of the plant Terminalia Tomentosa W. and A.
—अलक-संहति, इस्, f. rows of curls.
—अलका-
धिप (˚का-अध्˚), अस्, m. or अलकाधिपति (˚का-
अध्˚), इस्, m. a N. of Kuvera.
—अलकान्त (˚क-अन्˚),
अस्, m. the end of a curl, a ringlet.
—अलकेश्वर
(˚का-ईश्˚), अस्, m. a N. of Kuvera.

अलकम् अलकम्, ind., Ved. in vain, for
nothing.

अलक्त अलक्त or अलक्तक, अस्, m. (said to
be for अ-रक्त), the red resin of certain trees; or
perhaps the cochineal or its red sap.
—अलक्त-रस,
अस्, m. the Alakta juice [cf. the preceding].
आलाक्त आलाक्त. See under आल.

अलक्षण अ-लक्षण, अम्, n. (rt. लक्ष्), a
bad, inauspicious sign; (अस्, आ, अम्), having no signs
or marks; without characteristic, having no good
marks, inauspicious, unfortunate.

अ-लक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, unseen, unperceived, un-
observed, unlooked for; uncharacterized, having no
particular mark.
—अलक्षितान्तक (˚त-अन्˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, suddenly dead.
—अलक्षितोपस्थित (˚त-उप्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, one who has approached unobserved.

अ-लक्ष्य or अ-लक्षणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, invisible;
unmarked, not indicated; having no particular marks,
insignificant in appearance; (अस्), m., N. of a certain
weapon.
—अलक्ष्य-गति, इस्, इस्, इ, moving invisibly.
—अलक्ष्य-लिङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, disguised, incognito.

1. आ-लक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be observed, visible,
apparent.

आलक्ष्य 2. आ-लक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम् (3. आ pre-
prefixed in the sense of diminution), scarcely visible.

अलक्ष्मी अ-लक्ष्मी, ईस्, f. evil fortune, bad
luck, distress, poverty.

अलखान अलखान, अस्, m., N. of a king
of Gurjara.

अलगर्द अलगर्द or अलगर्ध, अस्, m. a
water-serpent, the black variety of the Cobra de Capello
(Coluber Nāga); (आ), f. a large poisonous leech;
(etymology doubtful.)

आलगर्द आलगर्द, अस्, m. a species of
Cobra. See अलगर्द.

अलग्न अ-लग्न, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. लग्), not
joined or connected.

अलग्ल अ-लग्ल, अस्, आ, अम्, speaking uncon-
nectedly; stammering.

अलघु अ-लघु, उस्, वी, उ, not light, heavy;
not short, long; weighty; serious, solemn; intense,
violent.
—अलघु-प्रतिज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, solemnly
pledged or promised.
—अलघूपल (˚घु-उप्˚), अस्,
m. a rock.
—अलघूष्मन् (˚घु-उष्˚), आ, m. in-
tense heat.

अलङ्करण अलङ्करण, अलङ्कार. See un-
der अलम्, p. 86, col. 1.

अलङ्-करण, अम्, n. preparation, the act of de-
corating, decoration; ornament.

अलङ्घन अ-लङ्घन, अम्, n. (rt. लङ्घ्),
not surmounting, not transgressing, not passing over
or beyond.

अ-लङ्घनीय or अ-लङ्घ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, insur-
mountable, impassable, not to be crossed; not to be
[]
transgressed, inviolable, venerable.
—अलङ्घनीय-
ता or अलङ्घ्य-ता, f. impassableness, insurmount-
ableness, inaccessibility; inviolability; respectability;
authoritative or absolute rule; superiority.
अलज अलज, अस्, m. a kind of bird.
अलज्ज अ-लज्ज, अस्, आ, अम्, shameless.

अलजी अलजी, f. inflammation of the eye,
at the edge of the cornea.

अलञ्जर अलञ्जर, अस्, m. an earthen water-
jar. See अलिञ्जर.
अलति अलति, इस्, m. a kind of song.
अलपत् अ-लपत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, not speaking.

अलब्ध अ-लब्ध, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. लभ्), un-
obtained.
—अलब्ध-नाथ, अस्, आ, अम्, friendless,
without a patron.
—अलब्धाभीप्सित (˚ध-अभ्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, disappointed in one's desire.
अ-लभमान, अस्, आ, अम्, not gaining, &c.
अ-लभ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, unobtainable, unattainable.

1. आ-लभ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. fit to be killed or
sacrificed.
2. आ-लभ्य, ind. having received or obtained.

अलम् अलम्, ind. (said to be fr. rt. अल्),
enough, sufficient, adequate, equal to, competent, able.
(अलम् may govern a dat., e. g. अलं जीवनाय,
sufficient for living; also a loc. or inf., e. g. अलं
विज्ञाने or विज्ञातुम्, able to conceive; also inst.,
e. g. अलं शङ्कया, enough, i. e. away with fear!
It may be used with the future tense, e. g. अलं
हनिष्यति, he will be able to kill; or with an indecl.
part., e. g. अलम् भुक्त्वा, enough of eating, i. e. do
not eat more; अलं विचार्य, enough of consider-
ation.)

अलङ्-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्तुम्, to prepare,
make ready; to ornament, decorate; to prevent from,
impede (with gen.).

अलङ्-कर्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, decorating, skilled in
decoration, a decorator.

अलङ्कर्मीण, अस्, आ, अम्, competent to any act,
skilful, clever.

अलङ्-कार, अस्, m. the act of decorating; ornament,
decoration; a figure or rhetorical expression.
—अलङ्-
कार-चन्द्रिका, f. title of a commentary on Kuvala-
yānanda.
—अलङ्कार-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, decorated,
ornamented; (ती), f. title of the ninth Lambaka in
the Kathāsaritsāgara; (वत्), ind. like an ornament.
—अलङ्कार-शास्त्र, अम्, n. a manual or text-book
of rhetoric.
—अलङ्कार-सुवर्ण, अम्, n. gold used
for ornaments.
—अलङ्कार-सूर, अस्, m., N. of a
kind of meditation in Buddhism.
—अलङ्कार-हीन,
अस्, आ, अम्, unadorned.
अलङ्कारक, अस्, m. ornament, decoration.

अलङ्-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, prepared, made ready;
ornamented, adorned.

अलङ्-कृति, इस्, f. ornament; rhetorical ornament,
figure or rhetorical expression.
अलङ्-क्रिया, f. adorning, ornamenting.

अलङ्-गामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, going after or following
in due or proper manner.
अलञ्-जीविक, अस्, आ, अम्, sufficient for livelihood.
अलञ्-जुष, अस्, आ, अम्, sufficient, adequate to.
अलन्-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, able, sufficient, having power.
अलन्-धन, अस्, आ, अम्, possessing sufficient wealth.
अलन्-धूम, अस्, m. thick smoke, smoke enough.

1. अलम्-पट, अस्, m. the interior of a house;
woman's apartment.

अलम्पट 2. अ-लम्पट, अस्, आ, अम्, not libi-
dinous, chaste.
अलम्-पशु, उस्, उस्, उ, able to keep cattle.

अलम्पुरुषीण, अस्, आ, अम्, fit for a man, be-
coming a man; sufficient for a man.

अलम्-बल, अस्, m. strong enough, having sufficient
power; an epithet of Śiva.
अलम्-भूष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, able, competent.

अलम्बुष अलम्बुष, अस्, m. (etymology
doubtful, though connected with अलम् above), the
palm of the hand with the fingers extended; vomiting;
N. of a Rākṣasa or evil spirit; (आ), f. a barrier, a
line or anything not to be crossed; a sort of sensitive
plant; N. of an Apsaras.

अलम्बुष; for ‘vomiting’ read a kind of plant
(= छर्दन).

अलाय्य अलाय्य, अस्, m. (fr. rt. ऋ?), Ved.
epithet of Indra or N. of a man; an assailant.
आलय आ-लय. See under 2. आ-ली.

आ-लय, अस्, अम्, m. n. a house, a dwelling, a re-
ceptacle, an asylum; (frequently at the end of a com-
pound, e. g. हिमालय, the abode of snow.)

अलर्क अलर्क, अस्, m. (etymology doubt-
ful), a mad dog or one rendered furious; a fabulous
animal, like a hog with eight legs; N. of the plant
Calatropis Gigantea Alba; N. of a prince.

आलर्क आलर्क, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अलर्क), caused
by or relating to a mad dog.
अलर्षि अलर्षि. See s. v. ऋ.

अलर्षि-राति, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. eager to bestow, ready
to grant gifts, one whose gifts are granted quickly.

अललाभवत् अलला-भवत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्,
Ved. becoming active or lively.

अलले अलले, ind. a word of no import
occuring in the dialect or gibberish of the Piśācas, a
class of imps or goblins, introduced in plays, &c.

अलवाल अ-लवाल or अलवालक, अम्, n. a
basin for water at the root of a tree.

आलवाल आलवाल, अम्, n. a basin for water
round the root of a tree. See अलवाल, आवाल.

अलस् अ-लस्, अस्, अस्, अस् (rt. लस्, to shine),
not shining.

अलस अ-लस, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. लस्, to labour),
inactive, without energy, lazy, idle, indolent, tired,
faint; (अस्), m. sore or ulcer between the toes; N. of
a small poisonous animal; N. of a plant; (आ), f., N.
of the climbing plant Vitis Pedata Wall.
—अलस-ता,
f. or अलस-त्व, अम्, n. idleness.
—अलसेक्षणा (˚स-
ईक्˚), f. a woman with languishing looks.

अलास अ-लास, अस्, m. (said to be fr. अ +
लास, saliva), inflammation and abscess at the root
of the tongue.

आलस आलस, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अ-लस), idle,
slothful, lazy.

अ-लसक, अस्, आ, अम्, indolent; (अस्), m. tympa-
nitis, flatulence, intumescence of the abdomen, with
constipation and wind.
अ-लास्य, अस्, आ, अम्, idle, lazy.
अलास्य अ-लास्य. See अ-लस above.

आलस्य, अस्, ई, अम्, idle, slothful, apathetic; (अम्),
n. idleness, sloth, want of energy.
—आलस्य-निबन्-
धन, अस्, आ, अम्, originating in indolence.

आलास्य आलास्य (˚ल-आस्˚), अस्, m. a croco-
dile (‘poison-mouthed;’ see आल).

अलाण्डु अलाण्डु, उस्, m., N. of a small
noxious insect or other animal.
अलात अलात, अम्, n. a fire-brand, coal.

आलात आलात, अम्, n. a firebrand; a coal
burning or extinguished. See अलात.

अलातृण अ-लातृण, अस्, m. (rt. ला = रा?),
Ved. not granting anything; a cloud.

अलाबु अ-लाबु, उस् or ऊ, ऊस्, f. (fr. अ, ‘not,’
and लब्, ‘to sink?’), the bottle-gourd, Lagernaria
Vulgaris Ser; (उस्, उ), m. n. a vessel made of the
preceding.
—अलाबु-पात्र, अम्, n. a jar made of the
bottle-gourd.
—अलाबु-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made of a
bottle-gourd.
—अलाबू-कट, अम्, n. the down of the
bottle-gourd.
अलाबु; add — (उ), n. the fruit of the Alābu.

आलाबु आलाबु, उस्, or आलाबू, ऊस्, f. a pump-
kin gourd. See अ-लाबु.

अलाभ अ-लाभ, अस्, m. (rt. लभ्), non-
acquirement; loss.

अलार अलार, अम्, n. (said to be fr. rt. ऋ),
a door.

आलक्ष् आ-लक्ष्, cl. 10. P. A. -लक्षयति,
-ते, -यितुम्, to descry, behold.

आलक्षण्य आलक्षण्य, अम्, n. (fr. अ-ल-
क्षण), misfortune, crime.

आलप् आ-लप्, cl. 1. P. -लपति, -पितुम्, to
address, speak to, converse: Caus. -लापयति, -यितुम्,
to engage (another) in conversation, to question.

आ-लाप, अस्, m. speaking to, addressing, speech,
conversation, communication; statement of the ques-
tion in an arithmetical or algebraic sum; a question.
—आलाप-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, speaking, addressing.
आलाप आ-लाप, &c. See under आ-लप्.

आ-लापन, अस्, आ, अम्, causing to speak or converse
about; (अम्), n. speaking to, conversing with.

आ-लापनीय or आ-लाप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be said or
spoken, to be spoken to or addressed.

आ-लापिन्, ई, इनी, इ, speaking or conversing with;
(इनी), f. a lute made of a gourd.

आलभ् आ-लभ्, cl. 1. A. -लभते, -लब्धुम्,
to take hold of, touch, handle.
आ-लभन, अम्, n. taking hold of, bringing (?).

आ-लम्भन, अम्, n. taking hold of, touching;
killing.

आ-लम्भनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be taken hold of or
handled, to be touched.
आ-लम्भिन्, ई, इनी, इ, touching, taking hold of.

आ-लम्भ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, obtainable, to be obtained;
fit or proper to be killed.

आलम्ब् आ-लम्ब्, cl. 1. A. -लम्बते, -बितुम्,
to rest or lean upon; to hang from; to depend; to
lay hold of, support, seize; to strike up (a tune or
note).

आ-लम्ब, अस्, आ, अम्, hanging down; (अस्), m.
that on which one rests or leans; support; receptacle;
a prop; an asylum; depending on or from; a per-
pendicular; (आ), f., N. of a plant with poisonous
leaves.

आ-लम्बन, अम्, n. depending on or resting upon,
[]
hanging from; supporting, sustaining; fundament,
base; reason, cause; (in rhetoric) the natural and
necessary connection of feeling with the cause which
excites it; the mental exercise practised by the Yogin
in endeavouring to realize the gross form of the
eternal; silent repetition of a prayer; (with Bud-
dhists) the five attributes of things corresponding to the
five senses, viz. form, sound, smell, taste, and touch;
also धर्म or law corresponding to मनस्.

आलम्बायन or आलम्बायनी-पुत्र, अस्, m., N.
of a teacher.
आ-लम्बि, इस्, m., N. of a pupil of Vaiśampāyana.

आ-लम्बित, अस्, आ, अम्, pendent, suspended, hang-
ing from or on; supported, upheld; protected.

आ-लम्बिन्, ई, इनी, इ, hanging from, resting or
leaning upon; depending on or from; laying hold
of, supporting, maintaining; wearing; (इनस्), m. pl.
N. of a school.

आ-लम्ब्य, ind. having supported; supporting,
sustaining; taking by the hand.

आलवण्य आलवण्य, अम्, n. (fr. अ-लवण),
ugliness, insipidity.

आलाट्य आलाट्य, अस्, आ, अम्, (rt. लट् for रट्),
Ved. being amongst the breakers of the sea (?).

आलान आलान, अम्, n. (etym. doubtful), the
post to which an elephant is tied; the rope that ties
him; a fetter, a tie; a rope or string; tying, binding;
(अस्), m., N. of a minister of Śiva.

आलानिक, अस्, आ, अम्, serving as a post to which an
elephant is tied.

आलावर्त आलावर्त (˚ल-आव्˚?), अम्, n. a fan
made of cloth.
